angleRead.name: Mason Ortega
angleRead.text: Mason's been thinking about the rhythm of neighborhood spots lately—how the same hands that pull espresso shots at OakTown Social also keep the pulse of Temescal alive. He wants to catch Vanessa Treary mid-shift, see how the place breathes when it's just another Tuesday. Not the grand openings or the late-night rushes, but the steady hum of work that holds a block together.

plan.focus: The unglamorous endurance of neighborhood work—what keeps someone like Vanessa Treary coming back to the same espresso machine, the same regulars, day after day.
plan.why: Because the A's might be heading to the World Series, but Temescal's real MVPs are the ones who keep the coffee flowing and the doors open.
